name: I-485 Adjustment of Status
summary: Stand-alone adjustment of status when the underlying petition (I-130, I-140, I-360 or other basis) is already filed or approved.

forms.title: Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status
Confirmation of Valid Job Offer or Request for Job Portability

when.question: basis
when.equals: Employment - approved I-140 with job offer

forms.note: Required for job-offer EB categories after I-140 approval (I-485 instructions, item 8). Not for NIW or EB-1A.

forms.title: Report of Immigration Medical Examination
forms.note: Submit with the I-485 or it may be rejected (item 9).

filing.where: See 'Where To File' on uscis.gov/i-485; the address depends on the filing category.

questions.label: What is your green card based on?
options: Employment - approved I-140 with job offer

questions.label: Receipt number of the underlying petition (I-130, I-140, I-360, etc.)
Have you ever held J-1 or J-2 exchange visitor status?
Do you want a work permit (I-765) while pending?
Do you need travel permission (I-131) while pending?

checklist.label: Government-issued photo ID (passport even if expired, driver's license, military ID)
Birth certificate from the civil authority (listing at least one parent)
Proof of last entry: passport admission or parole stamp, visa page, I-94
checklist.help: Not needed for asylees, VAWA self-petitioners, SIJ, T or U applicants, and 245(i) cases.

checklist.label: I-797 receipt or approval notice for the underlying petition
Marriage certificate and proof prior marriages ended (if a derivative spouse)
Proof of lawful status since arrival (all I-797s, I-94s, I-20s, DS-2019s)

when.question: basis
in: Employment - approved I-140 with job offer

checklist.label: Sealed Form I-693 from a civil surgeon
Certified police and court records for every arrest, charge or conviction
All DS-2019 / IAP-66 forms, J visas, I-94s, and proof the 2-year home residence rule is met or waived
Sponsor tax return or transcript, W-2s, pay stubs (for I-864)

coverLetter.re: Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status
coverLetter.request: We respectfully submit the enclosed Form I-485 on behalf of {{givenName}} {{familyName}}, based on: {{basis}}.
points: The applicant is eligible for adjustment in the stated category, as shown by the enclosed underlying notice.
The applicant was inspected and admitted or paroled, or is exempt from that requirement.
The required medical examination and supporting civil documents are enclosed.
